purpose: Evidence for the 2026-10-13 rewrite of /blog/find-all-pages-on-a-website/ into a methods guide (brief-2026-10-13.md).
sourceCommit: ebaabe3a (origin/main when the runs were made)
dates: UTC; started.txt 2026-10-13T07:25Z, finished.txt after the Google reads

runs.hosted-health.json: GET https://api.octocrawl.dev/health; it names no revision, so the hosted revision is not recorded here
runs.compare-mcp.json: node compare.mjs <this folder>: URLs normalised (host modelcontextprotocol.io only, no query or fragment, no trailing slash, decoded path limited to [\w-/.])
runs.status-archive-only-mcp.json: node status.mjs <this folder>: GET with redirect manual, user agent w2l-research/0.1, 3 at a time, 250 ms apart, 20 s timeout. Node fetch without NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, so these requests went DIRECT, not through the proxy. /_next/ URLs (disallowed by robots.txt) were not requested.
runs.gsc-url-inspection-octocrawl-dev.json: Search Console URL Inspection API for each of the 24 URLs in hosted-map-octocrawl-dev.json, operator's ADC login, quota project octopus-w2l-20260924-7r7, proxied
runs.gsc-performance-article.json: Search Console searchAnalytics for the article page, 2026-10-01..2026-10-13, dataState all, proxied
runs.serp-google-2026-10-13.json, site-search: Google read in the Claude desktop app's built-in browser, hl=en&gl=us&pws=0, proxied; result counts copied from the page
runs.followup-redirects-mcp.json: node followup.mjs <this folder>, after review: the 15 archive-only redirects whose target the map did not list, and /ecosystem (error in status.mjs), requested again following redirects; NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1, so proxied. 7 end on a page the map listed, 8 on a 404; /ecosystem answered 404.
runs.commoncrawl-collinfo.json: GET https://index.commoncrawl.org/collinfo.json after review, to record that CC-MAIN-2026-39 was the newest index listed (first entry); proxied
runs.sources-read.md: vendor and documentation pages read 2026-10-13 for the article's outside claims

notTried: Method 4 (a crawler such as Screaming Frog) was not run; the article cites the vendor page only.
